title: Hedging One’s Bets — an erroneous recorder’s report
shortTitle: Hedging One’s Bets — an erroneous recorder’s report
summary: B receives what appears to be a reliable report that A conveyed Greenacre to C, then accepts A’s earlier offer within its stated five-day period. The report proves wrong.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Does reliability rather than truth control indirect revocation under the provision cited by the problem? Was the promise to hold open independently enforceable? Separate those inquiries before deciding whether an acceptance power remained.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
